query.text: Kano Nigeria cadastral parcel GIS data land registry geospatial open data

results.title: Kano State Geographic Information System (KANGIS)
results.note: KANGIS is custodian of Kano geospatial data and supports computerized land registration, thematic maps and requested geospatial data; free anonymous parcel access not shown.

results.title: KANGIS Systematic Land Titling and Registration
results.note: Records individual plot survey/demarcation in designated areas; not a public feature API.

assessment: Strong official lead: KANGIS maintains statewide geospatial/land records and systematic parcel registration. No anonymous open parcel dataset or feature query endpoint was verified.
note: Native-language discovery only; does not change the historical registry or assert that no source exists.
